verdict.rationale: Statsig is a SaaS platform that ingests customer event and analytics data, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair privacy question for this kind of product. The evidence pack contains no documentation of a training opt-out, no data-usage policy, and no no-train commitment. The AI-related items cover OpenAI/Azure integrations, AI evals and MCP servers, which are not data-training controls.
